# Mitsubishi Motors by Richard Cuagdan

> Personal sales website of Richard Cuagdan, Mitsubishi Sales Executive at Mitsubishi SJ Legacy Motors, San Jose del Monte (SJDM), Bulacan, Philippines. Not the official Mitsubishi Motors Philippines website. Prices shown are official SRPs; promos are subject to bank approval.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://mitsubishipromos.online/): Mitsubishi lineup and SRPs
- [Cars](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/): every current model and variant with SRP
- [Budget calculator](https://mitsubishipromos.online/budgetcalculator/): match a unit to your income
- [Book a test drive](https://mitsubishipromos.online/test-drive/): Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM
- [Apply](https://mitsubishipromos.online/apply/): financing or cash application
- [About](https://mitsubishipromos.online/about/) and [Contact](https://mitsubishipromos.online/contact/)

## Models
- [Mirage G4](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/mirage-g4/): A compact, fuel-sipping sedan that is easy to park around SJDM and Metro Manila and gentle on a first-car budget.
- [Xpander](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/xpander/): The family MPV built around Filipino life: seven seats, high ground clearance for flooded streets, and a cabin that handles provincial trips.
- [Xpander Cross](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/xpander-cross/): Everything families like about the Xpander, with a rugged crossover look and a more premium cabin.
- [Xforce](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/xforce/): A compact SUV with bold styling and a raised driving position, sized for city streets but ready for out-of-town weekends.
- [Destinator](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/destinator/): Mitsubishi's newest 7-seat SUV, with a turbocharged 1.5L engine and a roomy, tech-forward cabin.
- [Outlander PHEV](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/outlander-phev/): Mitsubishi's plug-in hybrid SUV: drive on electricity for everyday trips and let the gasoline engine take over for long ones.
- [Montero Sport](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/montero-sport/): The full-size diesel SUV, including the Black Series. Built on a ladder frame for long drives, rough roads and heavy loads.
- [Triton](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/triton/): A tough diesel pickup that works hard on weekdays and still feels comfortable for the family on weekends.
- [L300](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/l300/): The workhorse of Philippine small businesses, available as a cab and chassis for custom bodies or as a ready-to-work dual-AC unit.
- [Versa Van](https://mitsubishipromos.online/cars/versa-van/): A full-size diesel van for shuttle services, company transport and big families who travel together.

- [How Car Financing Works in the Philippines](https://mitsubishipromos.online/guides/how-car-financing-works-philippines/): A plain-language walkthrough of bank car loans in the Philippines: SRP, down payment, amortization, terms, all-in packages and what happens after approval.
- [Car Loan Requirements: Employed, Business Owner and OFW](https://mitsubishipromos.online/guides/car-loan-requirements/): Checklist of the documents Philippine banks usually ask for in a car loan application, for employed applicants, self-employed business owners and OFWs.
- [Zero DP vs Low DP: Which Car Promo Is Right for You?](https://mitsubishipromos.online/guides/zero-dp-vs-low-dp/): Compare Zero Down Payment and low down payment car promos: upfront cash, monthly amortization, and how to decide based on your budget and savings.
- [OFW Car-Buying Guide: Buying a Car for Your Family Back Home](https://mitsubishipromos.online/guides/ofw-car-buying-guide/): How OFWs can buy and finance a car in the Philippines while working abroad: co-borrowers, SPA, documents, payments and release to family.
- [What Does 'All-In' Include in a Car Promo?](https://mitsubishipromos.online/guides/what-all-in-includes/): What an all-in Mitsubishi promo covers at SJ Legacy Motors: LTO registration, TPL, comprehensive insurance, chattel mortgage, free labor, warranty and freebies.
- [Xpander vs Xpander Cross vs Destinator: Which 7-Seater?](https://mitsubishipromos.online/guides/xpander-vs-xpander-cross-vs-destinator/): Compare the Mitsubishi Xpander, Xpander Cross and Destinator for Filipino families: engine, transmission, features and October 2026 monthly promos.
